entities.name: Uvilda Mistcoiler
entities.description: A djinn wizard and Dean of Perfection of the Prismari College at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Prismari College
entities.description: College within Strixhaven where Uvilda taught.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: Dean whose exuberant style tested Uvilda's patience.

entities.name: Veyran
entities.description: Took over Uvilda's role as Dean of the Prismari College.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Event in which most Strixhaven teachers were killed.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion most Strixhaven teachers are killed and Veyran takes over Uvilda's role.
events.quote: Uvilda's role as Dean of Perfection of the Prismari College was later taken over by Veyran .

relations.note: She taught at the Prismari College.
relations.quote: served as a teacher at the Prismari College within Strixhaven University
